arxiv-2112-02996.description: Abstract The paper introduces the Modular Pipe Climber III with a novel Three-Output Open Differential mechanism to eliminate slipping of the tracks due to the changing cross-sections of the pipe. arxiv-2208-00534.title: GENERALIZED LUTTINGER SURGERY AND OTHER CUT-AND-PASTE CONSTRUCTIONS IN GENERALIZED COMPLEX GEOMETRY
arxiv-2208-00534.creator: Lorenzo Sillari
arxiv-2208-00534.description: Abstract . Abstract . Exploiting the affinity between stable generalized complex structures and symplectic structures, we explain how certain constructions coming from symplectic geometry can be performed in the generalized complex setting. We introduce generalized Luttinger surgery and generalized Gluck twist along 𝒥 \mathcal{J} -symplectic submanifolds. We also export branched coverings to the generalized complex setting.

arxiv-2307-10304.title: Polyffusion: A Diffusion Model for Polyphonic Score Generation with Internal and External Controls
arxiv-2307-10304.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . We propose Polyffusion, a diffusion model that generates polyphonic music scores by regarding music as image-like piano roll representations. The model is capable of controllable music generation with two paradigms: internal control and external control. Internal control refers to the process in which users pre-define a part of the music and then let the model infill the rest, similar to the task of masked music generation (or music inpainting).

arxiv-2308-01341.title: Thermal effects in freeze-in neutrino dark mater production
arxiv-2308-01341.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . We present a detailed study of the production of dark matter in the form of a sterile neutrino via freeze-in from decays of heavy right-handed neutrinos. Our treatment accounts for thermal effects in the effective couplings, generated via neutrino mixing, of the new heavy neutrinos with the Standard Model gauge and Higgs bosons and can be applied to several low-energy fermion seesaw scenarios featuring heavy neutrinos in thermal equilibrium with the primordial plasma.

arxiv-2405-11283.description: Abstract One of the hot topics in hadron physics is the study of the new exotic charmonium states and the determination of their internal struture. Another important topic is the search for effects of the magnetic field created in high energy nuclear collisions. In this note we show that we can use ultra-peripheral collisions to address both topics.

pmc-11519907.description: Both microplastics and phytoplankton are found together in the ocean as suspended microparticles. pmc-12649852.creator: Luiza Czaczkowska, Ewa Jabłońska, Wioletta Ratajczak-Wrona, Randolph C Elble
pmc-12649852.description: Breast cancer is one of the most prevalent malignancies affecting women worldwide. pmc-13474767.description: The production of spontaneously fermented beverages worldwide relies on native microorganisms acquired incidentally through cross-contamination from environmental reservoirs. pmc-13629015.title: Exploring Hippuric Acid’s Putative Protective Role in Aging through In Silico and In Vitro Screening

pmc-13629015.description: Hippuric acid (HA) is a diet- and microbiome-derived metabolite consistently associated with healthy aging, yet whether it is a passive biomarker or an active effector remains unresolved.
